episodes.synopsis: As criminals known as Akudama terrorize Kansai, an ordinary citizen gets dragged into danger when her good intentions steer her wrong.
episodes.title: SE7EN

episodes.synopsis: The Akudama learn from the plan’s mastermind just how risky and troublesome it will be. As if things weren’t bad enough, trouble comes looking for them first.
episodes.title: RESERVOIR DOGS

episodes.synopsis: When the infiltration doesn’t go as expected and they’re running out of time, the group will have to improvise to pull off the ultimate heist.
episodes.title: MISSION: IMPOSSIBLE

episodes.synopsis: The Shinkansen speeds ahead, hurtling the crew towards certain death. As they race against time to reach the vault, Executioners show up to derail their plans.
episodes.title: SPEED

episodes.synopsis: As the Executioners deal with the aftermath of their failure, the Akudama take a break to recuperate and finally find out their destination.
episodes.title: DEAD MAN WALKING

episodes.synopsis: When one Executioner arrives for a showdown, Brawler couldn't be happier. As the bloodbath rages on, Pupil struggles to understand why she was left behind.
episodes.title: BROTHER

episodes.synopsis: After a long journey, the team finally reaches their destination. Before the children say their goodbyes, Brother shares his side of the story.
episodes.title: THE CITY OF LOST CHILDREN

episodes.synopsis: The Akudama struggle to survive as the hunt for their heads intensifies. While Doctor and Hoodlum run amok, Swindler takes on the role of big sister.
episodes.title: BLACK RAIN

episodes.synopsis: Courier joins up with Swindler as they attempt to track Brother down. Meanwhile, Cutthroat is seeing red and is thirstier than ever for blood.
episodes.title: THE SHINING

episodes.synopsis: Drastic measures are taken to subdue the civilian uprising. Knowing it's their last chance to save Brother, Courier and crew race towards a showdown at Kansai Station.
episodes.title: BABEL

episodes.synopsis: Sometimes, the truth is harder to believe than fiction. Unbeknownst to them, Swindler and Courier are at risk of being trapped in Kanto forever.
episodes.title: WAR GAMES

episodes.synopsis: Swindler and Courier have been driven into a corner but are not about to give up. Swindler is prepared to play the part if it will help the children escape.
episodes.title: AKUDAMA DRIVE
